§6Lathe§f is a 2x4x2 multiblock that turns ingots and plates into rods and wires. Every mid-tier AR machine depends on it because rods feed into the Precision Assembler, Centrifuge, and most rocket components.

The structure is compact: Structure Blocks form the walls, a Motor sits on top, with Input and Output Hatches on opposite ends. A Control Circuit Board (ic:3) marks the controller face.

Power draw is 20 RF/t while running. Recipes are registered at runtime and show up in JEI under Advanced Rocketry: Lathe.

§ePS:§f Right-click the Control Circuit Board with a Wrench to see the multiblock preview. This machine is a prerequisite for the Precision Assembler and Centrifuge.
